verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since accounting SaaS could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, but the evidence never documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The closest items are marketing copy about "automated invoices and reminders" and an invoice flag that emails payment reminders when an invoice goes unpaid. Neither states a user-defined recurring schedule, so they are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
